comment: Open (redistributable) test assets for GPU creative and 3D application tests. Each asset keeps its own licence. sha256 and size are pinned by 'build_test_assets.py pin'. source_kind: origin = stable source URL (no copy needed); public-mirror = open licence, unstable origin, also kept in the public bucket at mirror_path; private = redistribution prohibited (none in this file). 'synthetic' lists deterministic generated files (synth, pin-synth); they are not in the ISO unless --with-synthetic.

synthetic.description: 7680x4320 8-bit RGB PNG (red = horizontal ramp, green = vertical ramp, blue = repeating hash tiles), stored deflate blocks, about 100 MB: very large raster, memory and export scale

synthetic.name: tiff_16bit_big
synthetic.description: 4096x4096 uncompressed little-endian 16-bit RGB TIFF, one strip, about 100 MB: 16-bit pipeline and large-file scale

synthetic.name: wav_sine_sweep
synthetic.description: 48 kHz 16-bit stereo PCM WAV, 30 s, linear sweep 20 Hz to 20 kHz (left) and 20 kHz to 20 Hz (right), integer-only generation: audio import and playback

synthetic.name: uhd_testsrc2_10s
synthetic.description: 3840x2160 25 fps 10 s H.264 test pattern from ffmpeg testsrc2 (pinned command, bitexact flags); checked by a hash of the first bytes only because the encoder output can vary with thread count: UHD video decode and timeline scale
